_comment: One registry for every agent job-agent supports. scripts/gen-plugins.mjs turns it into agents/<id>.md (the steps for that agent, with its setup message) and agents/README.md. Edit this file, then run npm run gen:plugins.

agents.label: Claude Code
agents.signIn: Run `claude mcp login trueinterview` (or type `/mcp` inside Claude Code and pick trueinterview).

keyConfig.where: Run in your terminal. It replaces an earlier trueinterview entry.
keyConfig.text: claude mcp remove trueinterview --scope user 2>/dev/null; claude mcp add --scope user --transport http trueinterview {{URL}} --header "Authorization: Bearer {{KEY}}"

agents.note: Runs when you ask. For a daily run, set it up as a scheduled task in the Claude desktop app (it runs while the computer is awake). It applies with Claude in Chrome (start it with `claude --chrome`) or a Playwright MCP server; Chrome uploads files up to 10 MB. Allow Claude in Chrome on the job sites so it doesn't stop to ask on each one.

agents.label: Codex

keyConfig.where: Paste at the end of ~/.codex/config.toml (the Codex app and CLI share it), replacing any earlier [mcp_servers.trueinterview] block, then restart Codex.

agents.runPrompt: Run my job search now. Use the Codex Chrome extension to apply on company sites; for a site that needs me signed in, use Chrome, and list any role waiting on a sign-in instead of dropping it.
agents.note: Runs when you ask. It applies with the Codex Chrome extension: allow it access to file URLs so it can upload your résumé, and give it access to the job sites ahead of time. The Browser plugin can't upload files.

agents.label: Cursor
agents.signIn: Open Cursor Settings → Tools & MCP → trueinterview → Connect.

keyConfig.where: Cursor Settings → Tools & MCP → New MCP Server opens ~/.cursor/mcp.json. Add this entry inside "mcpServers" and save.

agents.note: Runs when you ask, in a new Agent-mode chat. It applies with Cursor's own browser, which may not upload files: for a form that needs the résumé, it gets the role ready and hands it to you. Turn on auto-run for the browser tool, or it asks before every step.

agents.label: Gemini CLI
agents.signIn: Inside Gemini CLI, run `/mcp auth trueinterview`.

keyConfig.where: Add this entry inside "mcpServers" in ~/.gemini/settings.json and restart Gemini CLI.

agents.note: Runs when you ask. Applying needs a browser MCP (see docs/browser.md); without one it gets each role ready and you submit it.

agents.label: OpenCode
agents.note: Runs when you ask. Applying needs a browser MCP (see docs/browser.md); without one it gets each role ready and you submit it.

agents.label: Meta Muse

keyConfig.where: When Muse asks for the key in its secure credential prompt, paste it there. Never paste it into the chat.

agents.note: Runs in the cloud every day, even with your computer off. It applies in its own cloud browser; Muse may ask you to approve a submit, and the run waits until you do.

agents.label: Manus

keyConfig.where: Paste the key into Manus's secure credential prompt. No prompt? Settings → Connectors → TrueInterview → Edit, and add the header `Authorization` with the value `Bearer <your key>`.

agents.note: Runs in the cloud every day, using Manus credits on each run. It applies in its own cloud browser; when a site needs you signed in or shows a CAPTCHA, it asks you to take over that browser.

agents.label: Grok

keyConfig.where: Paste the key into Grok's secure credential prompt. No prompt? Open the TrueInterview connector's settings and add the header `Authorization` with the value `Bearer <your key>`.

agents.note: Runs every day on the schedule you set up with it, in its cloud computer and browser.

agents.label: Qwen (千问办公)

keyConfig.where: In the 千问办公 desktop app: 扩展 → 连接器 → + 添加 → 粘贴 JSON 配置, paste this and import. Turn on its 浏览器 connector too: that is how it applies on company sites.

agents.note: Runs every day while your computer is on; a run is skipped while it is off or asleep, so turn on Keep System Awake. It applies with the 浏览器 (browser) connector in your own Chrome or Edge, so keep that browser open.

agents.label: WorkBuddy

keyConfig.where: In the WorkBuddy desktop app: 专家·技能·连接器 → 连接器 → 自定义连接器, add it with this, save, then trust TrueInterview when it asks.

agents.note: Runs every day while your computer is on; a run is skipped while it is off or asleep. Give the TrueInterview connector full access, or WorkBuddy asks before every call, the résumé download included.

agents.label: Another agent

keyConfig.where: Add TrueInterview as a remote MCP server ({{URL}}). If it offers a sign-in, sign in; otherwise give it the key in its credential or header settings (`Authorization: Bearer <your key>`), never in the chat.

agents.note: Any agent that can call a remote MCP server and use a browser that uploads files. If it can't schedule tasks, ask it to run when you want.
